remaining_limits: C05 21.75-23.25s jack transport is a time ellipsis. Weather, body posture and roof damage vary between shots. Continuous rotation, hand relocation and load transfer are not shown in full.

scope: All six reviewed by each reviewer with same criteria: hook, humor, event relevance, differentiation, corporate suitability, timing, captions, causal/prop/body continuity, ending and production feasibility.
